name: chart_per_company
note: AccountAccount company_ids (account_account_res_company_rel, addons/account/models/account_account.py:121) and the chart of accounts list per company: each account with its type, reconcile flag, parent and the companies it belongs to (active_test off)
source_sql: SELECT a.id, a.account_type, a.reconcile, a.non_trade, a.active, a.parent_id, r.res_company_id AS company_id FROM account_account a JOIN account_account_res_company_rel r ON r.account_account_id = a.id ORDER BY a.id, r.res_company_id

name: codes_per_company
note: AccountAccount._compute_code / _search_placeholder_code (addons/account/models/account_account.py:47-49, 340-405): the company-dependent code_store map flattened to one row per account and company
source_sql: SELECT a.id, c.key AS company_id, c.value AS code FROM account_account a, jsonb_each_text(a.code_store) c ORDER BY a.id, c.key

name: tags_and_default_taxes
note: AccountAccount.tag_ids and tax_ids (addons/account/models/account_account.py:116-130): how many tags and default taxes each account carries (the embedded relation arrays)
source_sql: SELECT a.id, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_account_account_tag r WHERE r.account_account_id = a.id) AS tags, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_account_tax_default_rel r WHERE r.account_id = a.id) AS default_taxes FROM account_account a ORDER BY a.id
